newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Moody's may upgrade W.Australia and Victoria.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Moody's may upgrade W.Australia and Victoria.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said it has placed the Australian states of Victoria and Western Australian on review for a possible upgrade.

On Victoria, Moody's said it had placed the state's Aa2 long term domestic currency rating on review and as a consequence the Aa2 ratings of the Australian dollar-denominated bonds and notes of the Treasury Corp of Victoria have also been placed on review for possible upgrade.
Likewise, the Aa1 long term domestic currency ratings of Western Australian and Western Australian Treasury Corp may also be upgraded.
Moody's pointed to Victoria's improved financial situation and the likelihood that reform will continue, in view of the strong political support enjoyed by the government.
"The review will focus on financial fundamentals, progress in privatization, and continuing efforts to restructure public services," Moody's said.

On Western Australia Moody's pointed to the state's strengthening fiscal position, improving net debt position and the government's strong commitment to reform. The review will also focus on financial fundamentals and developments in the state economy. -- Sydney newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
